QuestInfo.name: Something to Trade
QuestInfo.0: #b#p702##k has an idea for getting the Hollow through winter.
QuestInfo.1: Collect 30 #b#t4000052#s#k from #r#o55#s#k on the way to #b#m10002000##k, then bring them to #b#p304##k in #b#m10002000##k with the #b#t4031138##k from #b#p702##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p304##k agreed to trade. #b#p305##k will need time to pack the winter supplies for the Hollow.

0.0: The supplies we have will last the winter, but there are things we simply can't make down here. Things like cloth and proper medicine!
0.1: #b#m010002000##k has all of that, and #b#p700##k at the Cave Fairy Store has been worrying about winter for weeks. We just need something to offer in return...
0.2: So I made this: a #b#t4031138##k, from the #b#t4000051#s#k you gathered. Nothing on the surface glows quite like it.
0.3: #r#o55#s#k near the #b#m010006040##k area drop #b#t4000052#s#k, and #b#p700##k swears surface folk have uses for them. Bring some along, all right?
0.4: Would you take the lamp and #b30#k #b#t4000052#s#k to #b#p304##k in #b#m010002000##k, and ask if they'd be willing to trade?

yes.0: Thank you. Carry the lamp carefully. If the glass cracks, the spores scatter everywhere. And don't tell #b#p701##k where you're going, or she'll try to follow you.

no.0: I understand. It's a long way to carry a lamp. I'll be here if you change your mind.

1.0: You again? ...And you don't smell like rot this time. Goods from #b#m010006000##k? It's been a long time since anyone brought trade up that path.
1.1: And a #b#t4031138##k! Nobody up here makes these! Ellinia's tree houses could use a few on long nights.
1.2: I can use the #b#t4000052#s#k, too. Yes, I'll gladly trade for these.
1.3: Cloth and medicine for the winter... #b#p305##k keeps our spare supplies, but gathering enough for a whole village will take time.
1.4: And the bundle will be heavy, so the path down will be dangerous. Grow a little stronger, then come see #b#p305##k. And take these, for all the walking.

npc.0: Have you been to #b#m010002000##k yet? Take the #b#t4031138##k and #b30 #t4000052#s#k to #b#p304##k, all right?

item.0: I'll need to see the #b#t4031138##k and #b30#k #b#t4000052#s#k. If the lamp was lost, #b#p702##k may be able to make another.

lost.0: The lamp broke? Oh, that's all right. I have enough spores for another.
lost.1: Here's a new #b#t4031138##k. Take it to #b#p304##k in #b#m10002000##k, along with #b30#k #b#t4000052#s#k.
